content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (diagnosis codes R55,G45.9). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. Because the payer denied the claim under Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification, this appeal requests retroactive authorization for the medically necessary diagnostic procedure."}
